# PrimaryDisplay <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


```blitzbasic
PrimaryDisplay:Int32
```

**Returns:** The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays).

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The number of the main display, the one that [CountGfxModes](CountGfxModes) and the other graphics mode commands list the modes of. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.
